name: Tongue & bitter taste

overlay.caption: bitter chemical → tongue receptors → stronger signal if you inherited more of them

does: Shows the same bitter chemical tasting stronger to someone with more sensitive bitter receptors
Shows bitterness tasted rising with how bitter the food is
Shows sensitivity as something inherited, set by genes
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Include smell, cooking, habits or how taste changes with age
Say anything about what anyone should eat
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: If a food suddenly tastes very strange or you lose your sense of taste, tell an adult.
